title: Verify an order-eight cyclotomic-sequence linear complexity

source.citation: Linear complexity of Ding-Helleseth generalized cyclotomic sequences of order eight, arXiv:1802.08105

translation.notes: The source's two Sage routines are specialized to p=17 and q=41. The CRT cyclotomic generating polynomial gives complexity 696 by polynomial gcd, independently agreeing with the theorem's discrete-log formula.
